title: The Cloud's Purpose
source_detail: Description of how clouds are formed and bring rain
description: A fluffy cloud wonders what it's for until it brings precious rain to a thirsty land. A gentle story about discovering our special purpose.

pages.text: Once upon a time, in the wide blue sky, there was a little fluffy cloud named Nubi.
pages.illustration_prompt: A small, fluffy white cloud with big, cartoon eyes floating in a vast blue sky. Sunlight streams through, casting soft golden hues.

pages.text: Nubi watched other clouds form and drift by. 'What is my purpose?' Nubi wondered.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi looks curiously at larger clouds, which are moving together, forming shapes in the sky.

pages.text: The sun shone brightly, and Nubi felt warm and cozy, yet still curious.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi basking under a warm golden sun, surrounded by soft pink and orange hues of a setting sun.

pages.text: One day, a gentle breeze called, 'Come along, Nubi! We have a journey to take.'
pages.illustration_prompt: A playful breeze with swirling lines beckoning Nubi to move, as small birds fly alongside.

pages.text: Nubi floated along with the breeze, gathering tiny drops of water.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi floating gently, collecting sparkling water droplets, with lush green fields below.

pages.text: Slowly, Nubi grew bigger and fluffier, feeling a bit heavier.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi expanding, becoming a larger, puffier cloud, reflecting the sun's warm light.

pages.text: 'Why am I here?' Nubi asked the sky. The sky whispered softly, 'Patience, little one.'
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi gazing into the vast sky, with a gentle wind and whispers represented by swirling patterns.

pages.text: Below, the earth was dry, and the plants were thirsty, waiting patiently.
pages.illustration_prompt: A parched landscape with wilting flowers and dry grass, under a clear blue sky.

pages.text: Nubi felt a tug in its heart. 'Is it time?' Nubi wondered, feeling ready.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi glowing softly from within, with a gentle anticipation in its cartoon-like eyes.

pages.text: Then, in a magical moment, Nubi released tiny raindrops to the land below.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi showering sparkling raindrops over fields, bringing them back to life, with vibrant greens emerging.

pages.text: The earth drank happily, and flowers began to bloom with joy.
pages.illustration_prompt: Colorful flowers blossoming in vibrant detail, with animals peeking out curiously around them.

pages.text: Nubi felt a warm glow inside. 'This is my purpose!' Nubi realized joyfully.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi shining softly, surrounded by rainbows and fields that are lush and vibrant.

pages.text: 'You did well,' the sky said, as Nubi floated on with a happy heart.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi drifting calmly, with a gentle smile and a serene sky full of colorful hues.

pages.text: As the sun set, Nubi felt the peace of knowing its special purpose.
pages.illustration_prompt: A serene sunset scene with Nubi glowing warmly, surrounded by tranquil colors of dusk.

pages.text: Nubi settled in the night sky, whispering goodnight to the world below.
pages.illustration_prompt: Nubi nestled against a starry night sky, with twinkling stars and a crescent moon casting gentle light.

pages.text: The earth sighed contentedly, as Nubi drifted off to sleep, dreaming sweet dreams.
pages.illustration_prompt: A peaceful night scene with Nubi gently fading into the night sky, embracing the stars and moon.
